pages.title: Einstein-Rosen Bridge
pages.text: A wormhole made solid: one mouth here, the other somewhere far away, joined by a throat through curved spacetime. Peering into it, I see the far side foreshortened and tinted. It does not hum or spin; it simply connects.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Einstein and Rosen found their bridge in the Schwarzschild solution, but it pinches shut too fast to cross. I propped the throat open with an Einstein-Rosen Core, framed it in horizon glass and tidal alloy, and it stayed open.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Inside a Black Hole.
